description: Run one SQL statement against an app's PostgreSQL addon (owner/admin only). Read-only by default: the statement runs in a READ ONLY transaction that is rolled back. With allow_write=true it CAN WRITE: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and DDL (DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE) are committed immediately and cannot be undone. Before setting allow_write, show the user the exact SQL and get their explicit confirmation. Results are capped at 1000 rows; statements time out after 15s.

allow_write.description: Must be true for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL; default false = read-only

name: runzero_db_query
title: Run SQL query
